external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Kong Fo restaurant Google profile: rating 4.5/5, 75 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: I don't know why there are so little reviews. The food is authentic and very nicely seasoned. I think Pho is even too intensive and taste very rich. Bun Cha Gio even better than you could imagine. I also was surprised how good the Bento was.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Kong Fo is an Asian cuisine restaurant in Kongsberg. The restaurant has a nice interior with lots of seating. They have a large variety of dishes and the servers were very attentive. Everything I tried was delicious, the spring rolls were perfectly crispy and the fried rice was packed with flavor. I also tried the bubble tea which was refreshing and sweet.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Nice place with good and friendly service. We ordered 2 Boba teas. The matcha tea was not mixed well, the tapioca balls were starchy and weird inside almost like they weren’t prepared properly. The other boba was very strong and bitter. Other than that it was fine. But we couldn’t finish the teas.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Waitress took time to provide us service and just stood at the bar. Took a long time for the food to be served given that there were only two tables at that time; us and one man on the other table. We ordered: stektris and pad thai. Boba was okay. Food was great but not a fan of their service.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Refreshing boba and tasty food😋
Peaceful atmosphere with relaxing music and friendly staff. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.
